{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lali Plague''' was a great plague that caused incredible amounts of geopolitical damage when it swept across a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Its effects were often covered in political science classes.
